fix_subject: Fix chained function calls on case-insensitive column matches
pr_title: Chaining a macro onto a column referenced with a different letter case

labels.summary: Chaining a function call onto a column referenced with different letter case (e.g. `x.lower()` where the column is `X`) failed because the column reference kept an alias from the case-insensitive match; the fix clears the alias before the column is passed as the function's first argument.
